title: Redesign the kanban board with minimal Foreman-native polish
body: Improve the board's visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, state distinction, and action affordances while preserving Foreman's restrained, clean look. Board already reads theme::live (no colour literals in src/board.rs). Ranked after qn5tfb (stable card numbers) and etxvs5 (per-project + in the sessions panel) — those are smaller and unbuilt. Verify with screenshots.
